name: manifold_benchmark_binary
description: A dataset of binary-labelled examples intended to evaluate models on simple two-class discrimination tasks, robustness, and calibration. It is used to measure how reliably models can separate two categories across varied inputs and to benchmark binary decision behavior. The data are suitable for standard binary classification metrics and quick diagnostic evaluations.
reputation: A low-profile binary benchmark with limited community adoption, typically used for targeted diagnostics rather than broad leaderboard comparison.
